Diphenhydramine di(acefyllinate) is giv- en as an antiemetic for the prevention and treatment of motion sickness. The usual oral dose is 90 to 135 mg, which may be repeated if necessary at intervals of at least 6 hours, to a maximum of 540 mg daily. Other diphenhydramine salts that have been used include the polistirex, the salicylate, and the tannate by mouth, the methylbromide rectally, and the metilsulfate applied topically. Dimenhydrinate (p.576) is diphenhydramine teoclate and mefenidramium metilsulfate is diphenhydramine methylsulfomethylate.
